To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a deep learning technique for fully automated abdominal organ segmentation with high accuracy, and practical memory and computing time demands.

we developed a deep learning based automated multi-organ segmentation (ALAM0) technique that can accurately segment 10 organs at risk (liver, spleen, left and right kidney, pancreas, stomach, duodenum, small intestine, vertebral bodies and spinal cord) in a single abdominal magnetic resonance (MR) image with a high Dice Similarity Index (DSC) of 0.8 0.97.
we developed a deep neural network based automated multi organ segmentation technique for clinical abdominal MR images that achieves high accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a DL-based method that is capable of automatically segmenting a large number of abdominal OARs from MR images.

a fully automatic segmentation of multiple abdominal organs at risk (liver, spleen, stomach, duodenal bulb, pancreas, small intestine, left/right kidney, vertebral bodies, and spinal cord) on abdominal magnetic resonance imaging.
the problem of automated segmentation of multiple organs in abdominal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed technique is a promising tool for automated segmentation of abdominal OARs in MR images.
the proposed ALAMO model is an effective, accurate, and efficient technique for automated abdominal organ segmentation.
the ALAMO technique is a promising tool for automated abdominal multi organ segmentation with high efficiency, accuracy, and reliability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a deep learning technique for fully automated abdominal multi organ segmentation with high accuracy, efficiency, and reliability, which is a critical step toward MR only treatment planning for abdominal cancers.
we have demonstrated a fully automated multi organ segmentation technique for abdominal MR imaging with high accuracy and efficiency.
we developed a deep neural network model to segment ten abdominal organs in MR images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning can be used for multi OAR segmentation with high performance and efficiency.

deep learning based segmentation can be used to generate segmentation labels with high quality and efficiency, thus facilitating the clinical implementation of MR only radiation therapy and MR guided adaptive treatment of abdominal cancer patients.

the ALAMO technique can be used in clinical practice to reduce the laborious manual segmentation process, and to provide a more efficient and reliable method for OAR segmentation in abdominal MR images.
